decisions: The five-step demo is a narrative workflow rather than a dashboard.
Implemented and conceptual features carry persistent, explicit badges.
The legacy private scenario was replaced with a synthetic bread-and-plant experiment.
The demo uses no remote fonts, images, APIs, storage, or analytics.
Independent review corrected the result highlight so it is not presented as a per-result chat-context selector.
External embeddings remain clearly distinguished from the default local Ollama path.
